name: Shadowed Hearts
source:
An unfamiliar forest. A strange, shadowy creature lurking in the distance. And worst of all-- no memories to speak of. Play as Ciri (renamable) as she works to recover her missing memory in the small town of Dewberry Village. Discover magic, fight monsters, and fall in love!

[from [url=https://snowfiedev.itch.io/shadowed-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一片陌生的森林。一个奇怪的、阴暗的生物潜伏在远处。最糟糕的是——没有记忆可言。扮演希里（可重命名），在杜伯里村小镇努力恢复她丢失的记忆。发现魔法、对抗怪物并坠入爱河！

[来自[url=https://snowfiedev.itch.io/shadowed-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
